explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The statement is built entirely from the library's own definitions: `ideleLayerCorInfl`, `NormalLayer.artinCharacterCup`, `ideleFormation`, `characterCarryCocycle`, `IdeleCoeff`, `H0`/`H2` for continuous cohomology, `explicitInfl2`/`explicitCor2`/`explicitRes2` and `galOfOpenNormalEquiv`. It says that inflating and then corestricting the Artin-character cup product at a finite layer gives the carry cocycle class of the character on the absolute Galois group. Mathlib has none of this class-field-theory machinery: no idele class formation, no continuous cohomology `H2` of profinite groups with these maps, and no carry cocycles of characters. The proof also relies only on the library's own lemmas, plus routine Mathlib facts such as `Subgroup.index_top` and `one_smul`. These do not carry the content of the theorem. I did not search Mathlib further, because none of the main constants exist there.
